value.content: {"id": "portswigger_essential_skills", "item_type": "methodology", "topic": "recon", "category": "PortSwigger Web Security: Essential Skills & Burp Suite Techniques", "name": "PortSwigger Essential Skills: Request Interception, Macros & Recon Methodology", "cwe": "CWE-699", "owasp_category": "A05:2021 - Security Misconfiguration", "signals": ["http_interception_flow", "macro_session_management", "dynamic_token_extraction", "content_discovery_fuzzing", "browser_devtools_profiling"], "verification_strategy": "Utilize Burp Suite Proxy and Repeater to dissect request structure, configure macros to maintain active sessions across anti-CSRF token rotations, and conduct structured content discovery across hidden directories and administrative interfaces.", "evidence_requirements": ["session_macro_trace", "http_transaction_log", "discovered_asset_inventory"], "tools": [{"tool": "BurpAgent", "cmd": "BurpAgent.intercept_and_inspect()", "desc": "Autonomous proxy interception and traffic analysis engine"}, {"tool": "ffuf", "cmd": "ffuf -u https://example.com/FUZZ -w /wordlists/raft-medium-directories.txt", "desc": "High-speed directory and file brute-force engine"}, {"tool": "BrowserAgent (Firefox)", "cmd": "BrowserAgent.run(target, mode='auto')", "desc": "Automated Firefox-esr browser exploration and session token extraction"}], "remediation": "Enforce defense-in-depth: strict input validation, principle of least privilege, centralized access control, and comprehensive audit logging across all application surfaces.", "description": "PortSwigger Essential Skills curriculum teaches mastering Burp Suite Proxy, Repeater, Intruder, Match and Replace rules, macro session management, and systematically profiling target web applications."}
